Deine Schnitte entscheiden über Gewinn oder Verlust

Wir schalten Meta- und TikTok-Ads für Brands aus Health, Beauty, Supplements und Finance — von Beauty-Konzernen bis zu schnell wachsenden D2C-Marken. Bei uns landet dein Video nicht im Feed-Nirvana: Es geht mit echtem Budget live, und die Zahlen sagen dir jeden Tag, ob dein Schnitt funktioniert.

Aufgaben

  • Du schneidest Direct-Response-Video-Ads für Meta (Facebook/Instagram) und TikTok: UGC-Style, Talking-Head und VSL-Formate
  • Pro Konzept erstellst du ein Hauptvideo plus mehrere Hook-Varianten und Kurzversionen (z.B. 30–40 Sekunden)
  • Du baust aktiv B-Roll, Grafiken, Captions und Produkt-Visuals ein — starre Talking-Heads ohne visuelle Sequenzen gibt es bei uns nicht
  • Du kombinierst echtes Creator-Footage mit KI-generiertem Material (z.B. Arcads, Higgsfield)
  • Du setzt Pflichttexte und Sternchen-Hinweise sauber um (Health-Compliance)
  • Du arbeitest mit klaren Briefings: Script als Doc, Footage im Drive, Task in ClickUp — Kommunikation läuft über Slack

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Schnitt von Social Ads / Kurzform-Content (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut oder vergleichbar)
  • Direct-Response-Verständnis: Die ersten 3 Sekunden entscheiden. Du schneidest auf Retention, nicht auf Ästhetik-Preise.
  • Tempo und Zuverlässigkeit: Deadlines sind bei uns keine Empfehlung. Wenn eine Ad Dienstag live gehen muss, ist sie Dienstag fertig.
  • Detailgenauigkeit: Du liest Briefings vollständig und stellst Produkte korrekt dar
  • Eigenständigkeit: Du stellst die richtigen Fragen zum Start — und lieferst dann, ohne dass jemand hinterhertelefonieren muss
  • Bonus: Du hast Lust auf KI-Video-Tools und neue Workflows, statt sie zu fürchten

Benefits

  • 100 % Remote und freie Zeiteinteilung
  • Direktes Feedback von Media Buyern: Du bekommst Hook Rates und Performance-Daten zu deinen Videos zurück
  • Steile Lernkurve in Performance Creative: Du siehst als einer der wenigen Cutter die echten Zahlen hinter deinen Schnitten
  • Kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen, kein Meeting-Marathon
  • Regelmäßige Events, Treffen und Weiterbildungen

Deine Schnitte entscheiden bei uns über Gewinn oder Verlust und genau deshalb bekommst du Verantwortung, Daten und ehrliches Feedback statt Agentur-Politik.

jobs.title: AI Marketing Operator
jobs.description:
Remote (European time zones) · Full-time · Start: Q4 2026 · Quarterly in-person team events

Apply with: CV + LinkedIn profile

We are not looking for a marketing person who understands AI. We are looking for an AI person with a marketing background.

About MultiBase

MultiBase is a Business Intelligence and Analytics consultancy with 35 years of experience guiding mid-sized companies in the DACH region to turn data into profit. MultiBase's 1,500+ projects. 400+ clients. Serving the DACH region since 1991. Our audience: CFOs and Heads of Controlling.

We are at an inflection point: shifting from traditional BI consulting to an AI-accelerated, IP-driven business built on our proprietary DECIDE framework. AI is not a tool here. It is an operational layer. Our founder creates the content and sets the strategy. Our AI agents write the copy. What is missing is the person who makes the whole machine run.

Tasks

The Role

You are the production and distribution engine of our marketing. Content direction and strategy come from the founder. Your job is to make that machine run at scale - and improve it as you go.

You report to the management. You will not be managed day-to-day, but you have a clear escalation path when a decision needs to be made. You interpret a brief correctly the first time, deliver without back-and-forth, and raise problems before anyone asks.

Concretely:

  • Own and run the marketing digital workforce: build, deploy, monitor, and improve AI agents and automated workflows across marketing and business development
  • Own the content calendar and the full publishing operation: YouTube uploads (titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, thumbnail briefings), LinkedIn scheduling, newsletter dispatch via our CRM. Zero missed publish dates
  • Build automations that remove manual steps from our workflows (agentic platforms, CRM automations, API integrations), so the human time required in marketing goes down, not up
  • Coordinate video production timelines with our editor and manage asset quality against the brief
  • Brief and steer an external paid-ads specialist: audience and ICP input, tracking setup (pixel, UTM), performance review against lead quality, not vanity metrics
  • Build and maintain an automated weekly performance report (YouTube, LinkedIn, newsletter, CRM) that management can read in 5 minutes
  • Produce and format supporting marketing assets: presentations, papers, website updates

Requirements

Who You Are

  • An executor, not a talker. Your value is that things ship, reliably, without anyone chasing you
  • Systematic by nature: you build checklists, SOPs, and processes because chaos offends you
  • AI-native: you work with AI agents as colleagues, not as occasional tools. You brief them, challenge their output, and push back when they are wrong
  • Self-correcting: when something breaks, you fix it fast and adjust the process so it does not break again
  • You care about outcomes (qualified leads, published assets, hours saved), not titles

Must-Have

  • AI-native, proven: daily, hands-on proficiency with at least one major agentic platform (n8n, Make, Claude Code / Cowork, OpenClaw, Hermes, or any comparable orchestration and automation platform). You have built and run agents and automated workflows, not just written prompts. This is the single most important requirement
  • 2+ years in a B2B marketing environment (agency or in-house), in a small team where you owned outcomes end-to-end
  • Content operations experience: you have run a content calendar and multi-channel publishing workflow (video, social, email) for a real brand
  • Marketing automation: you build workflows yourself, without engineering support
  • Paid ads literacy: enough to brief a specialist, review campaign performance, and catch obvious errors in targeting and tracking. You do not need to be the specialist
  • Business-level English required. German at any level is a meaningful advantage for this role
  • Self-directed: you do not need daily management

Nice to Have (Not Required)

  • German: a strong plus for reviewing and quality-checking DACH content
  • GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM experience
  • Short-form video production (Reels, Shorts), thumbnail creation, basic editing
  • Experience using LLM APIs (Claude, GPT) for marketing automation
  • B2B content marketing experience for mid-market DACH companies

This Role Is Not For You If...

  • Your primary identity is "I'm a creative" or "I'm a strategist". Strategy and creative direction are owned by the founder
  • You use AI "sometimes" and cannot describe specific workflows you have built
  • You need a detailed brief and daily check-ins for every task
  • You cannot name concrete results from your previous marketing work
  • You have only worked in large marketing departments with clear lane separation
  • You accept AI output without questioning whether it is right

What Success Looks Like

After 3 months:

  • You own the content calendar completely: zero missed publish dates
  • Management spends zero time on content logistics: they create, the machine handles the rest
  • At least two automations are live that removed manual steps from the current workflow
  • At least one paid campaign is running with clean tracking and a clear performance report
  • The automated weekly marketing report exists and takes 5 minutes to read

After 6 months:

  • A consistent flow of warm, qualified leads comes from content and paid channels, without management having to run marketing operations
  • The marketing digital workforce is operational, documented, and measurably reducing manual work every month

Benefits

What You Get

  • Direct access to management: zero layers, zero bureaucracy
  • A real digital-workforce mandate: you build and own the marketing machine
  • Full AI tool budget
  • Remote-first, core hours 10:00-16:00 CET
  • Quarterly in-person team weeks in Paphos, Cyprus
  • You will be joining a team of 17, working closely with our content and video production team
  • Compensation: competitive, based on experience and location, plus performance-based bonus

How to Apply

Send us your CV and your LinkedIn profile. Nothing else. No cover letter.

Optional: in three sentences, tell us what you have built with AI and what it did. This is not required - but it is the fastest way to stand out.

MultiBase GmbH is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants are evaluated regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

erlich textil wurde 2016 in Köln gegründet und produziert seitdem super comfy Basic-Unterwäsche, sinnliche Lingerie und Bettwäsche.

Dabei zeigt erlich echte Menschen mit echten Körpern und bietet zeitlose Schnitte mit maximalem Komfort – ohne Drücken und Einengen.

Wir suchen ab sofort eine:n Growth Marketing Manager:in – Paid Social, die/der unser Paid-Social Wachstum eigenständig verantwortet: von Media Buying über eigene Creative-Production bis Testing. Meta (Instagram & Facebook) ist dabei dein Zuhause und unsere absolute Prio. Du baust den Kanal so auf, dass wir erlich textil profitabel skalieren.

Aufgaben

🎯 Media Buying & Kampagnen (Meta): Du verantwortest unserem Meta Account end-to-end. Kampagnen-Setup, Struktur, Buying, tägliche Optimierung und Skalierung. Du entscheidest, wo das Budget hinfließt, und trägst die Verantwortung für die Ergebnisse. Natürlich stehen wir dir als Team immer zur Seite.

🚀 Full-Funnel & neue Kanäle: Du denkst gerne über verschiedene Awareness Stufen nach und bist nicht nur BOFU unterwegs, verstehst die Rolle von Vielfalt in Creative und verstehst Customer Journeys über mehrere Touchpoints. Und wenn Meta läuft, testest du TikTok und Pinterest als nächste Wachstumskanäle ;).

🎬 Eigenständige Creative Production: Du briefst nicht nur, du baust selbst. Von der Idee über Angles, Painpoints, Skripte und Hooks bis zum Schnitt produzierst du Performance-Creatives (Statics, UGC, EGC, Video). Schnell, iterativ und mit einem Auge für die Marke.

🤝 Creator- & UGC-Sourcing: Du findest, briefst und steuerst Creator:innen für performanten Content und baust dir einen Pool an Stimmen und Gesichtern auf, die zu erlich passen.

🧪 Testing & Iteration: Du fährst systematisch Creative-, Angebots- und Audience-Tests. Hypothese → Test → Learning → nächster Test. Verlierer killst du früh, Gewinner skalierst du konsequent.

📊 Zahlen & Attribution: Du steuerst nach Marge statt nach Klicks. Blended ROAS/MER, CAC und Contribution Margin, Attribution über KLAR. Du bist radikal transparent über die Performance, auch wenn's mal nicht läuft.

🤖 AI-native im Daily Doing: Du nutzt KI im Alltag für Creative-Iteration, Painpoints und Angles, Reporting und und und. Du baust dir Workflows, die dich schneller und besser machen und bringst richtig Lust und Energie für das Thema mit.

  • Bonus: Erfahrung in Fashion / Apparel / Lingerie oder Premium-DTC, im Shopify-Ökosystem, mit TikTok- / Pinterest-Ads

jobs.title: Salesforce Technical Architect (all genders)
jobs.description:
InfoTip digitalisiert seit über 25 Jahren Service-, Sales- und CRM-Prozesse für Kunden vom Mittelstand bis zu internationalen Marken.

Salesforce ist einer der wichtigsten Wachstumstreiber bei InfoTip. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die technische Herausforderungen nicht nur lösen, sondern die technische Richtung unserer Projekte aktiv gestalten möchten.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für die Architektur anspruchsvoller Salesforce-Lösungen und begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live. Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse, entwickelst tragfähige Architekturkonzepte, bewertest technische Optionen und stellst sicher, dass unsere Lösungen skalierbar, wartbar und zukunftsfähig bleiben. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Kunden, Projektleiter:innen, Functional Consultants und Entwickler:innen zusammen und bringst Deine technische Expertise sowohl in der Konzeption als auch in der Umsetzung ein. Es erwarten Dich abwechslungsreiche Projekte, moderne Salesforce-Technologien, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung.

Wenn Du gerne komplexe Anforderungen in durchdachte Architekturen übersetzt, technische Entscheidungen mit Überzeugung vertrittst und Freude daran hast, andere durch Deine Erfahrung besser zu machen, könnte diese Rolle genau die Herausforderung sein, nach der Du suchst.

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die technische Architektur anspruchsvoller Salesforce-Projekte.
  • Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst skalierbare Salesforce-Architekturen für unsere Kunden.
  • Du konzipierst Integrationen, Datenmodelle, Sicherheits- und Berechtigungskonzepte sowie Automatisierungsstrategien.
  • Du bewertest fachliche Anforderungen hinsichtlich ihrer technischen Machbarkeit und entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze.
  • Du arbeitest hands-on bei der Umsetzung komplexer Salesforce-Lösungen mit.
  • Du unterstützt unsere Entwickler:innen und Consultants bei Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen.
  • Du führst technische Reviews durch und stellst Salesforce Best Practices über alle Projektphasen hinweg sicher.
  • Du begleitest Kundenworkshops, Präsentationen und technische Abstimmungen auf Augenhöhe.
  • Du unterstützt Aufwandsschätzungen, technische Projektplanung und Presales-Aktivitäten.
  • Du entwickelst Dich kontinuierlich durch Salesforce-Zertifizierungen und neue Technologien weiter.

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung als Salesforce Technical Architect, Lead Developer oder in einer vergleichbaren technischen Führungsrolle.
  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der technischen Umsetzung komplexer Salesforce-Projekte.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Apex, Lightning Web Components, JavaScript, Flows und Salesforce Security.
  • Umfangreiche Erfahrung bei Integrationen sowie im Umgang mit REST-, SOAP- und weiteren API-Technologien.
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Architekturprinzipien, Datenmodellen und skalierbaren Salesforce-Lösungen.
  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud und idealerweise Field Service.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (Deutsch C1; Englisch B2) für souveräne Abstimmungen sowie die Präsentation technischer Konzepte vor Kund:innen und internen Teams.
  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Hohe kommunikative Kompetenz und die Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Mehrere relevante Salesforce-Zertifizierungen; idealerweise auf dem Weg zum Application Architect, System Architect oder vergleichbaren Architect-Credentials.

Benefits

  • Ein herausragend nettes und hilfsbereites Team mit großem Gemeinschaftssinn
  • Flexibles Arbeiten - hybrid in Georgensgmünd oder Bad Lippspringe sowie im Homeoffice
  • Viele Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Salesforce-Zertifizierungen
  • Regelmäßige Strategie- und Teamevents
  • Ein agiles Unternehmen mit iterativem Projektvorgehen
  • Top-Arbeits-Equipment
  • Selbstgepackte Adventskalender, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Bike-Leasing, Betriebliche Krankenversicherung uvm.

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Dir – über anspruchsvolle Salesforce-Projekte, Architekturentscheidungen und darüber, wie wir gemeinsam technische Standards setzen können, die Kunden nachhaltig begeistern.

Bewirb Dich bei uns, gestalte die Architektur moderner Salesforce-Lösungen, bringe Deine technische Handschrift in spannende Projekte ein und feiere gemeinsam mit uns die Erfolge, die aus exzellenter Beratung, starker Technologie und echter Zusammenarbeit entstehen.

Senior/Staff Product Engineer (Frontend) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a technology leader in the SaaS space? Join epilot!
We are looking for product minded engineers not only coders. We're seeking builders who bridge technical expertise with product strategy. If you're passionate about impactful software, apply now! (Learn more about our understanding of being a product engineer here)

epilot is building a SaaS product to sell complex products online, focusing first on solving ecommerce in the rapidly transforming energy market. Our mission: Make selling complex products as easy as selling a pair of shoes online.

As Software Engineer at epilot you will be a driving force in shaping this mission. What makes working as a Software Engineer at epilot so special? Our unique engineering culture is defined by a few core engineering principles:
Among others, you can expect freedom and r esponsibility because we hire smart people who we can trust. We operate by principles and expect our teams to cultivate a strategic mindset.

We believe in ownership: you build it, you run it. We subscribe to this core principle of the DevOps movement. There is no dedicated Ops team who you can pass on the responsibility to take your code and make sure it runs reliably and scales to customers’ needs.

You should always show, don’t tell: Deliver working software early and frequently. We believe in the basic Agile principle of “Release early and release often”. This approach helps us manage risk and make better decisions by creating fast feedback loops between ourselves and our users.

We design software API First. Before we write a single line of code, we design the APIs of a service in a way that any other team, whether internal to epilot or external, can use the APIs interface with our service without prior knowledge.

Does this sound like an environment you want to work in? Then you could bet the right person to be an engineer at epilot!

Check out our promise to you: promise.epilot.cloud


We "epilots" are a team of experts from the fields of software development, energy management, product management and sales. In order to bring our solution even faster to the top in the energy world, we are looking for you as a Senior Product Engineer (Frontend)


What awaits you

  • As a frontend developer you will work on the new and further development of our React applications

  • You are responsible for implementing user interfaces based on wireframes and screen designs by our UX designers.

  • You write unit and end-to-end tests for the features and applications you develop.

  • You help your team to analyze and correct errors

  • You are involved in the conception of new features as well as in the optimization of existing features

  • You are part of an agile, cross-functional team of backend and frontend developers as well as designers and product managers.

  • You will also work with other teams to make epilot an even better product

  • You’ll get familiar with our tech stack with microfrontends, serverless AWS and best-in-class developer tooling & automation. More info about our stack: Tech stack

What you bring

  • You have at least 4-5 years professional experience with JavaScript

  • You have experiences with  React (Hooks, global state management, routing), ES6, TypeScript, Webpack, ESLint

  • You enjoy implementing highly responsive user interface components using react concepts

  • Nice to have: Experience with GraphQL, Node.js, AWS

  • You have fun creating user-friendly UIs with CSS and HTML

  • Ideally you have already gained experience in an eCommerce environment

  • Basic understanding of application and cloud security principles, and how to build secure, reliable software.

  • Tech Stack: React, Svelte, TypeScript, GitLab CI/CD 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to help building the most successful SaaS platform in the energy market.

  • Start-up mentality: dynamic atmosphere and great team spirit.

  • A rapidly growing company with an open communication culture, motivated colleagues and an international corporate culture.

  • Exponential learning curve - epilot is growing rapidly and we expect the same from you. You never stand still, you are permanently challenged, you learn from your mistakes a la Fail Fast and Often.

  • Flexible working hours and remote work - You have an important appointment in the morning? No problem! You decide where and when you want to work.

  • A central location in the heart of Cologne with cool cafes around the corner (But of course full remote jobs are also available).

  • Performance is rewarded with us - We take your desired salary seriously and talk openly about it with you.

  • Transparency - We maintain a very flat and open corporate culture, everything is visible and open for discussion.

  • Regular team events such as carnival, the summer party, Christmas party, company breakfast and many more opportunities to get to know your co-epilots outside working hours. Our highlight event is our yearly epilot summit in the summer where you will meet your co-epilots from all over the world.

What to/we expect in your first 180day

-read full version: here-

By Week 1 you will:

  • Pair with a colleague and ship something. Small is fine, working is the point

  • Start learning the business: who our customers are, what we're building toward, why it matters

  • Connect with the team and empower the team

By Month 1 you will:

  • Own a topic: have your name on a topic, be the main driver of that topic from refinement to delivery. Already shipping the first iteration of it

  • Have a good understanding of the codebase and how our services connect

  • Know enough about our customers and domain to push back on bad ideas, including ours

By Month 3-6 you will:

  • Be the undisputed owner of your domain: the go-to person, the one who spots problems before they're reported and fixes them before they're assigned

  • Have shipped something that visibly moved a metric: adoption, reliability, performance, or revenue

  • Operate fully autonomously. You know when to decide and when to align

  • Raise the bar for the people around you, you push us forward, you are a multiplier. Not just through your own work, but through your reviews, your feedback, and how you onboard whoever we hire after you

We welcome applications from all backgrounds regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, disability, or sexual orientation

Requirements

As a Senior 3D Gameplay Artist (Animation & VFX), you'll play a key role in owning the visual and motion game feel of our gameplay mechanics, from greybox to shipped asset, so that objects read as fun before a player ever touches them. You'll work directly with art direction, game design, and gameplay engineers on All in Hole, a top-50 grossing title, on the elements players interact with most. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Own game feel end to end: take a mechanic from greybox and UX blockout through animation, VFX, and final sign-off
  • Animate gameplay objects by hand: idle, activation, interaction feedback, and state transitions, with real command of timing, weight, anticipation, and follow-through
  • Build VFX and shaders that land the hit: impact, feedback, and state change that communicate clearly without drowning the read of the object
  • Translate concept into 3D without losing its soul: match the intent, elevate the charm, and challenge the concept early when the gameplay asks for something different
  • Iterate directly in Unity: prefabs, colliders, animator state machines, and enough technical range to test your own ideas in minutes rather than hand them off

This is a great opportunity to own the craft that players remember most, on a game already in the global top 50, with no one ahead of you in the queue — the person in this seat sets the bar for how gameplay objects look, move, and feel.

Requirements

We are looking for someone with around +5 years of experience building 3D core gameplay animations in mobile games, and the humility, curiosity, ambition, and drive to make an impact fast. You're a great fit if you have:

  • 3D animation craft: hand-keyed work that gives personality and weight to objects that aren't characters, grounded in animation fundamentals rather than tooling
  • Strong VFX skills: particle systems and impact effects timed to reinforce readability, not decorate it
  • A core gameplay brain: you're a gamer, you read design intent off a prototype, and you can hold a real conversation with designers about why a mechanic is or isn't fun
  • Working fluency in Unity: blockouts, prefabs, animator and state machines, and the technical range to unblock yourself
  • Genuine shader ability: you can write and debug your own, not just wire up existing ones
  • Fidelity to concept: you hit the intent of a concept closely while making it better through the 3D pipeline
  • Clear visual communication: storyboards and blockouts that get every stakeholder seeing the same outcome before work starts
  • Autonomy and initiative: you hold a quality bar without it being checked for you, and you bring the unrequested improvement alongside the requested one

Bonus points if you:

  • Can concept the idea yourself and push it forward
  • Have worked with physics-based gameplay
  • Have mentored or reviewed other artists' work

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.
